Ricochet Quirk.name: Ricochet Quirk
Ricochet Quirk.description:
🥏 A flick of your fingers sends a spinning disc of kinetic energy skipping off hard surfaces. You can hear each bank by its falling pitch.

🌱 At the start you can tap a target across a room or skip one shot around the edge of cover.
📈 With training: two-target banks, shots off moving backboards, and a crisscross net that stuns anyone who cuts through.
⚠️ Every bank costs speed and force. Cloth, turf, and other soft surfaces swallow a disc. After release its course depends on what it hits.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Visible Tell. If chosen, a bright ring forms between your fingers before each shot.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Snipe (Homing), for finding a shot around cover.

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Output +10, Quirk Control +10, Marksmanship +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Rim Tap, Chalkboard Bank
Ricochet Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: One palm-sized disc at first, up to eight meters of travel and one bank. Training reaches twenty meters of total travel per disc and three banks. Limits: Hard surfaces set the outgoing angle. Each bounce leaves less speed and force. Soft material swallows a disc, and a body ends its path. No steering after release. Quirk Strain: light: Rim Tap, Chalkboard Bank; moderate: Doorbell Double, Low Rail Skip, Moving Backboard; heavy: Balcony Buzzer, Paint the Key, Backboard Save, Triple Cushion Tag, Split Score; severe: Ringing Bounce Net. Type: Emitter. Law: The user answers for a stray disc after its last bank. Look: Bright rims leave a dotted trail and ring lower at each bounce.
